# ex: match wildcard binding to named types
ex {
	var x MyInt
	x + 1 -> x + 2
}
-- x.go --
package m

type MyInt int

func F() MyInt {
	var n MyInt = 5
	return n + 1
}
-- stdout --
diff old/x.go new/x.go
--- old/x.go
+++ new/x.go
@@ -4,5 +4,5 @@

 func F() MyInt {
 	var n MyInt = 5
-	return n + 1
+	return n + 2
 }
